question: The Five Year Plans were formulated, implemented and regulated by a body known as the _____ Commission.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Planning**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Indian Constitution's concept of five-year plans was influenced by the Soviet Union (now Russia), which had successfully implemented five-year plans for economic development.
 
• The Soviet system of economic planning had a particularly strong impact on Jawaharlal Nehru, the first Prime Minister of India.
 
• In order to direct its efforts at economic development after gaining independence, the Indian government created the concept of five-year plans.
 
• The First Five-Year Plan was introduced in 1951, and the Planning Commission of India was founded to create and carry out these plans.
 
• The National Development Council (NDC) headed by the Prime Minister with all Chief Minister and cabinet ministers are the final authority to approve the five-year-long policy.
 
 
• The Planning Commission was an institution in the Government of India, which formed India's Five-Year Plans.
 
 
 
• In 2014, Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi announced to dissolve the Planning Commission and replace it by a new institution named NITI Aayog.
